exposure: induction of labor (IOL) after successful external cephalic version (ECV)
cohort: Women who underwent IOL after successful ECV compared to women who underwent IOL with spontaneous cephalic presentation
finding: Induction of labor after successful ECV was associated with an increased risk of CD compared to IOL with spontaneous cephalic presentation, particularly among nulliparous women.
mod_finding: This study found that induction of labor after successful ECV in nulliparous women increased the risk of cesarean delivery compared to induction of labor with spontaneous cephalic presentation.
